page: Microsoft Azure ND40rs_v2 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance within the NDSv2 family, virtualized on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is provisioned with 40 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an Intel processor, alongside 672.0 GB of system memory. This architecture yields 16.8 GB of RAM per vCPU, providing a high memory-to-core ratio suited for large dataset caching and memory-intensive data preparation phases alongside accelerator execution.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by eight NVIDIA V100 GPUs delivering an aggregate total of 256 GB of GPU VRAM. The instance supports RDMA networking capabilities for multi-node clustering and distributed compute operations. Local storage consists of a 3114 GB solid-state drive (SSD), supplemented by support for Azure Premium Storage to accommodate high-throughput I/O pipelines. The instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource allocation perspective, the instance aggregates high-density GPU compute and substantial host memory into a single operational footprint. Concentrating eight accelerators within a single dedicated host eliminates inter-host network hops for intra-node parallel jobs, optimizing resource density for complex workloads. The platform is configured for distributed deep learning training, large-scale AI model inference, scientific simulations, and high-performance compute workloads requiring extreme multi-GPU parallelism.
description: Microsoft Azure ND40rs_v2 is a dedicated GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance built on Microsoft Hyper-V and an x86_64 Intel processor architecture. Configured with 40 dedicated vCPUs and 672.0 GB of system memory, the instance delivers 16.8 GB of RAM per virtual core. It integrates eight NVIDIA V100 GPUs providing an aggregate of 256 GB of VRAM, tailored for parallel execution and complex numerical computation. Ephemeral high-capacity storage is supplied by a 3114 GB local SSD, supplemented by RDMA interconnect capabilities and compatibility with Premium Storage tiers. Zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. By concentrating eight accelerators within a single dedicated host footprint, the instance optimizes resource density for high-throughput parallel compute pipelines. Microsoft Azure ND40rs_v2 is primarily engineered for distributed deep learning training, AI model inference, complex computer vision pipelines, and accelerated high-performance scientific simulations.
